Claire (People Ops): Drafting a tight manager+mentor checklist for Diego's first week and 30/60/90 measurable goals. Copyable, paste into calendar. Thoughts?
Evan (Hiring Manager): Love it. Make sure mentor rubric includes how to surface blockers and confidence levels.
onboarding-bot: Diego M profile created, payroll ping sent. :white_check_mark:
Rishi (IT): Laptop ordered, will enable SSO and send MFA link once Diego confirms email. ETA 48h. If urgent, we can expedite.
Diego (New Hire): Thanks! Quick Q: is there a standard docker image for local dev?
Mae (Buddy): Use `rdw/dev:latest` and follow the README in infra/docs/dev-setup.md. I'll pair on first run.
Claire (People Ops): Manager checklist (pasteable):
- Day -1: confirm shipping + SSO email + Slack invite + payroll docs
- Day 1 09:00: Welcome (People Ops + Manager) 30m
- Day 1 10:00: Team overview & role context 45m
- Day 1 14:00: Dev environment pairing (Buddy) 60m
- Days 2-5: Short tech deep dives (CI, infra, APIs) 30-60m each
- EOW: 30m manager check-in + 15m mentor rubric review

Mentor rubric (15m checkpoints):
1) Blockers (concrete asks)
2) Confidence on setup (scale 1-5)
3) One thing learned + next small task

30/60/90 measurable outcomes (edit per role):
- 30d: fully reproducible dev env, complete 2 small tickets, PR merged to infra repo
- 60d: own a feature scope, run CI jobs, participate in oncall shadow
- 90d: deliver a small project, present a short demo and retrospective

Who to ask: IT = @Rishi, Infra = eng-infra, Buddy = @Mae, People Ops = this channel, Security = eng-security

Evan (Hiring Manager): I'll send the intro email template and set weekly 1:1s for 90 days.
Mae (Buddy): I'll do daily 15m check-ins Wed-Fri first week and then Mon/Wed next two weeks.
Rishi (IT): Diego, once you confirm email I'll send VPN + MFA steps.
Diego (New Hire): Got it, I'll confirm now. Thanks all! :pray:
